headline: SPF 50 in a daily routine
footnote: AI illustrations, not real results. Individual results vary.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pure white seamless paper backdrop, soft daylight from the upper left, a faint grey contact-shadow area on the right. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty space, evenly lit, for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left half as a calm empty area for copy. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
photography_needed: Real, consented, unretouched before/after photos from a documented study of this product (same person, light and framing), with the study's claim and duration on file.
caption: Light Fluid SPF 50 Sunscreen: Apply on cleansed face after serums and moisturisers, generously and evenly on face and neck, at least 15 minutes before sun exposure; AM, every day. Labelled SPF 50, PA++++; the lab basis is in the footnote. The two frames are AI illustrations, not results.
adaptation_notes: Format #12 Before / after: copy is the product and its usage only (no result wording); the two AI frames show a very small realistic difference and carry the AI label; Severe by house rule.
writer: stand-in (Claude agent) following prompts/pipeline_brief_writer.md; user rules 2026-10-05 (active + strength shown, basis in footnote, no exaggeration, nothing pending)
frames_prompt: two equal side-by-side panels of the same Indian woman in her mid 30s with medium-brown skin outdoors in light shade, identical close crop of cheek and temple, framing, angle and soft daylight from the upper left. Left panel: a faint natural flush on the cheek after time outdoors; right panel: the same flush only slightly less noticeable. The difference is small and realistic, never dramatic; skin keeps natural pores and texture.
